# `Bitwise`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Bitwise — bitwise operations on `Int`.

Mirrors elm/core `Bitwise`.  Each function is aliased to its runtime
kernel via the `Kernel.kernel` mechanism.

`Int` is 64-bit two's-complement here, so `complement` and
`shiftRightZfBy` cover the full 64-bit width rather than wrapping at
Elm's 32 bits.  A shift offset is masked to the low 6 bits (`offset & 63`)
before it shifts, so every offset is total: no offset ever panics or
shifts a bit out of range.  See the `arithmetic` topic guide.

## `and`

```ipe
and : Int -> Int -> Int
```

Bitwise AND.

## `or`

```ipe
or : Int -> Int -> Int
```

Bitwise OR.

## `xor`

```ipe
xor : Int -> Int -> Int
```

Bitwise XOR.

## `complement`

```ipe
complement : Int -> Int
```

Bitwise complement (flip every bit).

## `shiftLeftBy`

```ipe
shiftLeftBy : Int -> Int -> Int
```

Arithmetic left shift.  `shiftLeftBy offset n` shifts `n` left by
`offset` bits.

    Bitwise.shiftLeftBy 1 5 == 10

## `shiftRightBy`

```ipe
shiftRightBy : Int -> Int -> Int
```

Arithmetic (sign-preserving) right shift.

    Bitwise.shiftRightBy 1 32 == 16

## `shiftRightZfBy`

```ipe
shiftRightZfBy : Int -> Int -> Int
```

Zero-fill (logical) right shift: the sign bit is not replicated.
